records.historical_exposure: Historical 2021–2026 years were already observed during development. Exclusion from a later fit is not investigator-wide blindness. This log opened no raw forecasts, protected 2017–2019 targets, normalized holdouts, credentials or runtime records.
records.instrument_contract: UNG ETF gas P&L; legacy Summer uses the continuous NG=F proxy only for confirmation/sizing. Remaining exposure uses 80/20 VOO/QQQM. UNG expenses and roll effects are embedded; this is not NG futures execution.

costs_timing_contract.priceConvention: Yahoo daily split-and-distribution-adjusted open and close
costs_timing_contract.signalTiming: prior close holdings earn close-to-open returns; the current target becomes effective at the current adjusted open
costs_timing_contract.initialState: already invested in the configured VOO/QQQM fallback at the prior close
costs_timing_contract.turnoverConvention: absolute signed pre-trade weight to target weight, summed across UNG, VOO, and QQQM
costs_timing_contract.benchmarkConvention: gross 80/20 VOO/QQQM daily target-weight close-to-close return
costs_timing_contract.selectionRule: cost and execution parameters are frozen before candidate evaluation and must never be optimized for return
costs_timing_contract.costCalibration: aggregate all-in research allowances; replace only with a separately versioned calibration built from stored historical quotes and fills

baseline.borrowBasis: default live routing opens UNG shorts only when Alpaca reports easy-to-borrow status

frozenSelectionScore.description: Average the train and validation improvements versus carry in Sharpe and Calmar; apply a small turnover penalty. Holdout is excluded.

next_batch_rule: Retry with a different economic, source or measurement contract, a finite frozen budget and new future evaluation. Retuning parameters or reusing an opened holdout does not create fresh proof. A failed configuration is not a universal hypothesis rejection.
